DEFINE INSTRUMENT improved_guide(w_in=0.03, w_out=0.02, m_coat=2.5, ncount=1e6, seed=12345)
DECLARE
  TRACE
COMPONENT origin = Progress_bar() AT (0,0,0) ABSOLUTE
COMPONENT source = Source_simple(xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.1, dist=1.5, 
                                  focus_xw=0.03, focus_yh=0.03, 
                                  E0=81.81/5.0^2, dE=81.81*(1/(5.0-0.5)^2 - 1/(5.0+0.5)^2)/2) 
  AT (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE
COMPONENT guide = Guide(w1=w_in, h1=w_in, w2=w_out, h2=w_out, l=10, m=m_coat) 
  AT (0, 0, 1.5) ABSOLUTE
COMPONENT divmon = Divergence_monitor(xwidth=0.02, yheight=0.02, ndiv=100, 
                                      xmin=-0.5, xmax=0.5, ymin=-0.5, ymax=0.5, 
                                      Lmin=4.5, Lmax=5.5, restore_neutron=1) 
  AT (0, 0, guide.z + 0.05) ABSOLUTE
COMPONENT sample_monitor = Monitor_nD(xwidth=0.02, yheight=0.02, 
                                      options="lambda x y", restore_neutron=1) 
  AT (0, 0, guide.z + 0.05) ABSOLUTE
END
```
